applications_approval_recorded.name: applications_approval_recorded
applications_approval_recorded.value: "applications"."state" not in ('APPROVED', 'APPLIED', 'SCREENING', 'INTERVIEW', 'FINAL_INTERVIEW', 'OFFER', 'ACCEPTED') or "applications"."approved_by" is not null

candidate_profiles_salary_range.name: candidate_profiles_salary_range
candidate_profiles_salary_range.value: "candidate_profiles"."salary_min" is null or "candidate_profiles"."salary_max" is null or "candidate_profiles"."salary_min" <= "candidate_profiles"."salary_max"

jobs_salary_range.name: jobs_salary_range
jobs_salary_range.value: "jobs"."salary_min" is null or "jobs"."salary_max" is null or "jobs"."salary_min" <= "jobs"."salary_max"
